title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
subheading: Nine sectors · one view · Refreshes Mondays ~12:30pm
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. The AI trade broke on Nov 5 (S&P 500 −4.4%, its worst day since April 2025; Nasdaq about −5.5%) on fears of state limits on data-center construction, then half-recovered Friday as AMD jumped 11% and Nvidia gained 2.8%. Palantir (revenue +96%, guide raised to ~$8.53B) and AMD (record $13.38B, Data Center +97%) both beat.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is proven; financing is the constraint. OpenAI closed the first $11B of its round at $1.25T (vs a $1.4T aim), and Anthropic's amended S-1 shows ~$17B of Q3 revenue against ~$895B of commitments, with IPO talk down to $1.25–1.75T from ~$2T. The Anthropic roadshow, its price range and Nvidia (~Nov 17) are the next reads.

sector_scoreboard.story: Agility Robotics began trading as AGLT on Nov 5, the first US-listed pure-play humanoid, and enters the board at Watch: more than $300M of Digit orders but pre-revenue, with a 180-day lock-up overhang. Rockwell (FY26 sales +8% to $8.99B, but Q4 only +1%) and Teradyne's profitable robotics unit anchor the industrial side.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Industrial demand is real (IFR sees 655K installs in 2026) while humanoids still trade on demos: Tesla's Optimus is in early production with no revenue and Figure carries ~$39B on ~150 robots shipped. Rockwell's investor meeting (Nov 18) is the next scheduled read.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Rheinmetall cut FY26 guidance again on Nov 5 and fell up to 16%, and the drone group sold off after the midterms before rebounding 9–15% on Nov 6 (Ondas +15%, Red Cat +14%, AeroVironment +9%) on no company news.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The continuing resolution to Dec 11 still blocks new starts on 150+ programs, and Jefferies sees the FY27 budget nearer $1.15T than the $1.5T request; L3Harris's record $53.2B backlog keeps the core intact. Anduril's tender closes today, Ondas reports Nov 12 and Rheinmetall's capital markets day is Nov 27.

sector_scoreboard.story: Centrus moves from Speculative to Avoid after Q3 revenue fell 26% to $55.5M with a gross loss and DOE's FY27 budget left the HALEU cascade (~$0.8B of backlog) unfunded. Oklo jumped ~19% on a narrower loss, but the group fell 9–14% on Nov 4–5 after the midterms before bouncing on Nov 6.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Oklo holds $3.13B of cash against $1.86M of revenue with Aurora due 2028–29; Constellation trades near 19.8x forward earnings vs a 26x average and reports Q3 today. The group still trades as high-beta AI-power exposure.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. MP Materials beat Q3 (revenue +176% to $147.7M, adjusted EPS $0.04, GM magnet qualification complete) yet closed Nov 6 at $35.41, down ~24% in a month. Lynas posted record NdPr output of 2,082t, and Albemarle's EBITDA rose 186% but it guided Q4 lower on lithium pricing.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: China's rare-earth suspension lapses Tuesday Nov 10 even though MOFCOM says the US arrangement runs to Jan 10, 2027; the two published dates conflict and no extension notice had appeared by Nov 7. USA Rare Earth reports today after the close and Lithium Americas on Nov 13.

sector_scoreboard.story: Redwire moves from Watch to Avoid after a Q3 revenue miss ($109M vs ~$126.5M expected), −$66.4M of free cash flow and a 21% drop to $6.13. The group fell again on Nov 5 (Planet Labs −12%, Intuitive Machines −15%), while NASA's Nov 7 Moon Base awards spread work across eight CLPS vendors.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: SpaceX's first public print beat (revenue $14.6B, +161%) but ~52% of it is now AI, and Q4 capex is guided to $35–40B. Rocket Lab and AST SpaceMobile report tonight, Starship Flight 15 is listed for Nov 13 pending approval, and ~797.6M SpaceX shares unlock around Dec 8.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Tesla's Q3 storage deployments of 13.7 GWh missed the ~15.9 GWh estimate and its margin leaned on a $526M tariff refund; GE Vernova fell ~10.5% on Nov 4 on financing fears and political risk to ~55% of the data-center pipeline. Eos revenue grew 171% at a −53% GAAP gross margin.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Fluence replaced its CEO and CFO on Nov 2 and sits near its 52-week low; Stem pushed Q3 to Nov 16 amid an NYSE notice and a strategic-alternatives headline. Energy Vault reports Nov 10, Fluence ~Nov 23, and China's battery export tax rebate ends Jan 1.

sector_scoreboard.story: Two upgrades: Tempus AI moves from Watch to Speculative after revenue +23% to $411.5M, its first clearly positive adjusted EBITDA ($25.6M) and a raised $1.60B guide; Guardant moves from Avoid to Watch on revenue +36% and Shield at 83K tests, though its cash-burn guidance widened to $205–220M.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: No AI-discovered drug has full FDA approval out of 200+ in development. Lilly sits near a record on a $91–92B guide, within ~7% of the average target. Intellia, CRISPR and Relay report around Nov 9, Nvidia on Nov 17, and Intellia's PDUFA date is Mar 10, 2027.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. The group snapped back on Nov 6 after Q3 prints: IonQ +23.4% to $32.62 on a record $173.8M quarter and a guide of $505–515M, Quantinuum +26% to $37.57 on revenue +233% and a raised guide, Rigetti +19.3%. IBM brought a 120-qubit System Two online on Nov 7.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: About half of IonQ's revenue is SkyWater foundry business, its GAAP operating loss was $433M and the headline profit was a non-cash warrant gain. Rigetti and D-Wave trade near 290–350x trailing sales and report Nov 10 after the close.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Five stance moves: earnings quality lifted Tempus and Guardant, balance-sheet stress cut Centrus and Redwire
cross_cutting_themes.description: Tempus AI goes from Watch to Speculative and Guardant from Avoid to Watch after raised guides, Agility Robotics enters at Watch on listing, while Centrus (Spec to Avoid) and Redwire (Watch to Avoid) are cut after Q3 misses with negative cash flow. The other 94 positions held in a week the Nasdaq fell 3.4%.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The AI trade broke on Nov 5, not on demand but on where the next build-out dollar comes from
cross_cutting_themes.description: The S&P fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq about 5.5% as state limits on data-center construction, negative hyperscaler free cash flow and valuation fears converged; AMD +11% and the chip index +4% on Nov 6 recovered part of it. Anthropic IPO talk slid to $1.25–1.75T from ~$2T, and OpenAI closed $11B of a round once aimed at $30B at $1.4T.

cross_cutting_themes.title: A hot jobs print and a VIX of 25.6: payrolls +165K vs ~60K expected, 10-year at 4.86%
cross_cutting_themes.description: The VIX rose ~32% on the week, gold gained ~4.6% to about $4,080 (the hedge worked), WTI fell ~13% to about $90 on the midterm result and Middle East diplomacy talk, and bitcoin slipped ~2% to ~$75.9K. October CPI on Tuesday is the next input. Market-wrap figures are secondary-sourced and differ slightly between outlets.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Midterm aftermath meets two hard dates: Nov 10 rare earths and Dec 11 funding
cross_cutting_themes.description: Democrats won Congress, hitting AI-power (Constellation −9%, Vistra −14%) and drone names before a partial rebound. China's suspension of its Oct 2025 rare-earth controls lapses Nov 10 despite a stated Jan 10 truce date, and the stopgap budget expires Dec 11 with 150+ defense new starts frozen.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Anthropic's roadshow turns IPO supply into a calendar: a reported $80–100B at $1.25–1.75T before Thanksgiving
cross_cutting_themes.description: FT-sourced figures; no price range or share count had been filed as of the latest sources, and Kalshi odds of a pre-December listing were above 80%. Around 797.6M SpaceX shares unlock ~Dec 8, Agility's 180-day lock-up has begun, and dilution (IonQ, Oklo's ATM, Rocket Lab) remains a recurring sector bear case.

news_of_the_week.title: S&P 500 −4.4% in its worst day since April 2025; chips −12%
news_of_the_week.description: Nasdaq about −5.5% on fears of state limits on data-center construction; AMD (+11% to $449.04) and Nvidia (+2.8%) rebounded Nov 6, but the week still closed S&P −2.7%, Nasdaq −3.4% and VIX 25.64.

news_of_the_week.title: October payrolls +165K vs ~60K expected; unemployment 4.1%
news_of_the_week.description: Wages rose 0.4% m/m and the 10-year ended at 4.86%; the beat keeps the Fed-path debate alive after the Oct 28 hold with two dissents for a hike.

news_of_the_week.title: Anthropic roadshow reported under way; FT says $80–100B at $1.25–1.75T
news_of_the_week.description: The amended S-1 (Nov 2) showed Q3 revenue ~$17B and a $567M operating loss; no price range or share count yet, with a debut targeted before Thanksgiving (Nov 26).

news_of_the_week.title: Agility Robotics lists as AGLT after holders approve the SPAC
news_of_the_week.description: More than 84% approval on Nov 2 and ~$465M of gross proceeds; first US-listed pure-play humanoid with >$300M of Digit orders, entering the board at Watch.

news_of_the_week.title: Tempus AI beats and raises; stance moves up to Speculative
news_of_the_week.description: Revenue $411.5M (+23%), adjusted EBITDA $25.6M and a $1.60B guide; Guardant followed with revenue +36% but a wider cash burn and moved from Avoid to Watch.

week_ahead.title: Rocket Lab, AST SpaceMobile, Constellation and USA Rare Earth Q3; Anduril tender closes
week_ahead.description: Rocket Lab guided $250–265M of revenue; Constellation tests its $11.50–12.50 EPS guide; Intellia and CRISPR report around the same day (estimated).

week_ahead.title: US October CPI; China's rare-earth suspension lapses; Rigetti, D-Wave, Energy Vault and Firefly Q3
week_ahead.description: CPI prints at 8:30am ET; the rare-earth binary hits MP, USAR and Lithium Americas (Nov 13) while quantum names report after the close.

week_ahead.title: Anthropic roadshow and reported listing window
week_ahead.description: Price range and share count are the next disclosures; the debut is targeted before Thanksgiving and is not confirmed by the company.

week_ahead.title: Starship Flight 15 and Vulcan return
week_ahead.description: First attempted ship catch, listed for 22:45 UTC pending regulatory approval; dates may move.

week_ahead.title: Nvidia Q3 FY27 (date per quote pages)
week_ahead.description: The biggest read-through for the AI-capex trade after the Nov 5 rout; Rockwell's investor meeting follows on Nov 18.

stance_changes.name: Agility Robotics
stance_changes.why: Newly listed (Nov 5) with >$300M of milestone-based Digit orders, but pre-revenue, cash-burning and subject to a 180-day lock-up overhang — wait for post-listing price discovery.

stance_changes.name: Centrus Energy
stance_changes.why: Q3 revenue fell 26% to $55.5M with a gross loss and an adjusted loss, and DOE's FY2027 budget doesn't fund the HALEU cascade (~$0.8B of backlog) nor further contract options — the research does not support owning it here.

stance_changes.name: Redwire
stance_changes.why: Q3 revenue of $109M missed by ~$17M, free cash flow was -$66.4M and the stock fell 21% to $6.13; the record $619.7M backlog and 32.3% gross margin do not offset a full-year guide that now needs a heavy Q4 and shipment-timing risk into 2027.

stance_changes.name: Tempus AI
stance_changes.why: Q3 revenue $411.5M (+23%), first clearly positive adjusted EBITDA ($25.6M) and a raised $1.60B guide justify upgrading from Watch, but growth is slowing from +50% and it still trades on a ~$13B cap with a GAAP loss.

stance_changes.name: Guardant Health
stance_changes.why: Q3 revenue +36% to ~$361M, Shield at 83K tests and a third raise show a real business, but cash-burn guidance widened to $205-220M and the TwinStrand appeal is open; moved up from Avoid.
